name: slop-o-meter
description: Metrics-driven detection of AI-generated code slop for Claude Code

budget.title: Slop budget
budget.description: Advisory score budget per turn. Slop-O-Meter observes; it never blocks edits.

mascot.title: Płanetnik
mascot.description: Show Płanetnik, the storm spirit who judges each turn, in the band and the /slop pane.

guard.title: Guard
guard.description: off: observe only. nudge: short mid-turn notes to Claude when it piles up pattern-named abstractions, weakens types, or rewrites one file over and over. strict: nudges, plus a note to Claude after any turn over budget. Never blocks an edit; never changes a score.

milestones.title: Milestones
milestones.description: Earn milestones for good habits (clean streaks, Sunbreaks, no any, net-negative turns), with a toast when one is earned.
